target_description.input_format: Arbitrary byte slices (simulating untrusted network input)
assertions: Must not panic on any input — either succeeds or returns an error
Deserialized proof must have valid internal structure if accepted
target_description.critical_finding_criteria: Panic on arbitrary bytes, or acceptance of malformed proof data that passes verification

campaign_methodology.seed_corpus_source: Serialized StarkProof instances from existing test suite

campaign_results.notes: 60-second fuzzing campaign executed successfully. 36.9M executions at 604k exec/s with no crashes or panics. No malformed proof data was accepted — all invalid inputs were rejected gracefully via error returns. Highest throughput of all 7 targets due to fast-path rejection of invalid byte sequences. Corpus stabilized at 62 entries.
